_note: Applied through apply-ratified.mjs, the stored-artifact path. No model call: this artifact IS what was read and approved. Shape follows that applier's schema — existing_field_count counts DISTINCT field names (13), not def rows (37), because that is what the moved-target refusal compares.
_origin: The sprinkler-tree master `03 Pumps/S02 Pumps- CSP.doc` yielded zero checklist rows and was deleted in hygiene 7c(1). It did carry an eleven-field nameplate table, held out of that deletion and proposed on its own merits. The corpus teaching again: the one thing the empty master had was exactly the block the type was missing.
_the_gap: fire_pump carried 13 fields across 37 def rows, every one of them duty or controller — rated flow, rated pressure, rated speed, driver, motor HP/V/FLA, controller type, engine make and BHP, fuel tank, battery arrangement, jockey pump setpoint. NO IDENTITY BLOCK AT ALL. A def set that describes duty but not identity fails the register's first purpose: it can say what a fire pump is rated to do and cannot say which machine it is.

_not_proposed.Power (kW): `Motor Horsepower (HP)` exists and the table carries a `unit_imperial` column — a unit question on an existing field, not a new field. Printing the same quantity twice in two units is the trim failure that took heat_pump from 25 fields to 14.
_not_proposed.PUMPS / Installation and Mounting: table section labels in the source, not fields

types.standards_anchor: NFPA 20 · ULC/CAN nameplate marking · the firm's own S02 CSP master (03 Pumps/S02 Pumps- CSP.doc, table 2)

fields.why: No spec row: a specification names a basis of design; the shop drawing is where the actual make is committed.
The master's own wording. Fire pumps are commonly identified by size as much as by model number.
Installed only — a serial number does not exist at spec or shop-drawing stage.

The as-built impeller determines the actual curve. Carried at BOTH stages because a trim change between shop drawing and installation is exactly the discrepancy the three-column layout exists to catch.
The one field of the five a specification genuinely does call out. Neither `pump` nor `fire_pump` carries it today.
